# Print & Compatibility Checklist: Leitner compartments

**Purpose**: Validate the *quality of the requirements* for an artifact whose failures are permanent — paper is cut once — and for a change that must leave every existing project building identically.
**Created**: 2026-09-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It tests whether the requirements are *written* well, not whether the implementation works. For the latter see [quickstart.md](../quickstart.md).

## Printed Geometry — Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the divider's dimensions specified for *every* permitted margin, not only the default? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the physical clearance the 1.5 mm growth depends on recorded with its source measurement, rather than as a bare number? [Traceability, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the colour band's width derived from a stated tolerance rather than chosen, so a reviewer can disagree with the input instead of the output? [Clarity, Research §R1]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the two error terms the band must absorb — registration and cut — both named and quantified? [Completeness, Research §R1]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the bleed distinguished from the growth as a separate quantity with its own bound? [Clarity, Research §R1]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for what each divider face carries, including what it must *not* carry? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006a]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the requirement that colour never carries meaning alone stated for the divider specifically, not inherited by implication? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]

## Printed Geometry — Measurability

- [ ] CHK008 Can "colour reaches every cut edge" be objectively evaluated, i.e. is the displacement it must survive given a magnitude and a direction? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the interval and rule strings fixed by an enumerated table rather than described in prose? [Measurability, Spec §FR-017a, §FR-017b]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "the two faces are identical" stated in a form that can be compared, rather than as a design intention? [Measurability, Spec §FR-005]

## Placement Rule — Clarity & Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Is the placement rule expressed as positions with a stated minimum clearance, rather than as grid indices? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004] *(retargeted 2026-09-07: dividers left the grid)*
- [x] CHK012 Is the reason dividers left the grid recorded — including the superseded attempt — so a later reader finds a decision rather than an unexplained asymmetry? [Traceability, Research §R1 superseded, §R6] *(retargeted)*
- [ ] CHK013 Do the page-count figures in the success criteria follow from the placement rule, rather than being asserted independently of it? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK014 Is it stated how a divider is located, now that it is not located by a grid index? [Completeness, Data model §1] *(retargeted)*
- [x] CHK015 Is the block stated to be always placeable, whatever the deck size? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004] *(retargeted; still closed — a fresh page offers the full 200 mm)*

## Backwards Compatibility

- [x] CHK016 Is "byte-identical output" scoped to a stated set of inputs, or left as an unbounded claim? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK017 Is the compatibility guarantee stated for both `--sides` values and both grids, or only for the defaults? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements defined for a settings file that exists but is empty? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK019 Are requirements defined for a settings file carrying a key that #67 will legitimately add later? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the "absent means the previous behaviour" rule stated in the same terms the project already uses for `goal.md` and the optional catalog keys? [Consistency, Contracts §formats]

## Settings States

- [ ] CHK021 Are all three states — absent, declined, answered — enumerated with a distinct required behaviour each? [Completeness, Data model §2]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the reason "absent" and "declined" must not collapse into one state written down? [Clarity, Data model §2]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the precedence between an explicit flag and the settings file stated explicitly rather than implied by ordering? [Clarity, Contracts §cli]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the two failure modes — unknown key and invalid value — specified precisely enough to be asserted separately, and is the reason they differ recorded? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016a, §FR-016b]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the shape of the file constrained in a way that keeps #67 additive, rather than merely hoped to be compatible? [Assumption, Spec §FR-019]

## Run Output

- [ ] CHK026 Are the advisory lines specified by required *content* rather than by exact wording, so a rephrasing is not a spec violation? [Clarity, Contracts §cli]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the requirement that dividers and cards are counted separately traced to the existing assertion it protects? [Traceability, Spec §FR-012a]
- [x] CHK028 Are requirements defined for output when several advisory conditions hold at once? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012b] *(retargeted: the `--margin 0` advisory no longer exists)*
- [ ] CHK029 Is it stated which single command owns each advisory, given the questions moved from `build` to `setup`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §FR-014]

- [x] CHK030 Is the acyclicity claim expressed as a graph that can be checked — and checked against the **real** imports rather than the constitution's stale copy? [Measurability, Research §R2]
- [ ] CHK031 Is each new `scripts/` module justified against the existing module considered first, as Principle V requires? [Traceability, Plan §Structure Decision]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the ink-rule amendment scoped to the new artifact, with explicit wording that it does not loosen the rule for cards? [Clarity, Plan §Design amendment]
- [ ] CHK033 Are the requirements that cannot become assertions identified individually and by name, rather than deferred as a category? [Completeness, Spec §Testability note]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the claim that Principle XI's run-output carve-out does not apply here argued from evidence in the test suite, rather than assumed? [Traceability, Spec §Testability note]

## Dependencies & Prerequisites

- [ ] CHK035 Is the crop-mark defect specified as a separate deliverable with its own failing assertion, rather than folded into this feature's scope? [Completeness, Plan §Ordering]
- [ ] CHK036 Are the consequences of the prerequisite *not* landing first stated, so the ordering is a requirement and not a preference? [Dependency, Research §R3]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the independence from #84 argued, rather than merely claimed? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the assumption that no new fixture is needed supported by the demo project's actual card count? [Assumption, Research §R4]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK041 Is "the box fits A8 only" stated once as a constraint and referenced, rather than restated in several places that could drift? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Every item asks about what is *written*. An item that cannot be answered from the artifacts is itself the finding.
- 55 items (41 at first writing, 14 added in the second pass); 53 carry a traceability reference (95 %). CHK015, CHK017, CHK018, CHK019 and CHK028 were `[Gap]`/`[Coverage]` probes, expected to fail on the first pass. That is what they did.

### First pass, 2026-09-07 — eight items closed

| Item | Finding | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| CHK019 | FR-016 made an unknown key fatal, so a file written by a #67-aware version would brick an older one — defeating FR-019 | split into FR-016a (unknown key → warning, run continues) and FR-016b (invalid value on a known key → hard error) |
| CHK016 | "byte-identical" was an unbounded claim | closed together with CHK017 |
| CHK017 | SC-005 scoped compatibility to "the demo project" without naming the axes this feature changes code on | SC-005 now names both grids, both `--sides` values and `--margin 0` |
| CHK018 | an existing-but-empty settings file was unspecified between "absent" and "declined" | empty is treated as absent (US2 scenario 8, data-model §2) |
| CHK028 | output when several advisory conditions hold at once was unspecified | FR-012b: independent, cumulative, each once, stable order |
| CHK015 | the placement rule was not stated to be always satisfiable | FR-004 now says a fresh sheet always satisfies both conditions |
| CHK039 | US2 scenario 4 still said "the question is not asked again", wording from when `build` asked | rewritten as "no advisory line appears" |
| CHK041 | the A8 constraint was restated in three places | FR-009 is now the single statement; three sites refer to it |

### Second pass, 2026-09-07 — after the cross-model review

The review returned NOT READY and the geometry changed, so this checklist was
re-run rather than carried forward.

- **Five items were retargeted, not deleted**: CHK011, CHK012, CHK014, CHK015
  and CHK028 asked about grid rows, the "row above" rule and the `--margin 0`
  advisory. None of those exists now. The *questions* they encode are still worth
  asking, so each was rewritten against the replacement and marked
  `(retargeted)`; deleting them would have lost the reason they were written.
- **CHK030 was sharpened**: the acyclicity claim must be checked against the
  **real** imports, because `constitution.md:256-266` omits `cardid` and
  `figures`. A test written against the documented graph would pass while the
  repository disagreed with it.
- **Fourteen items added** (CHK042–CHK055) across three new sections: the
  reworked geometry, build-internal correctness, and settings.

All eighteen new-or-retargeted items pass against the reworked artifacts. That is
expected — they were written *from* the remediation — so their value is as
regression questions for the PR, not as discovery. The genuine discovery this
round came from the cross-model review, not from this checklist.

The remaining 29 items are review questions for the PR, not defects.
